subject: Mutual Action Plan — sprint card & decision milestones (BrightLane)
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@brightlane.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan — sprint card & decision milestones (BrightLane)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan so we can align on owners and dates. I kept this intentionally short so your execs can skim. If anything is off, tell me and I’ll update the doc.

Key pain & outcome we heard
- Current latency and cost of your in‑house LLM serving is blocking ML model rollout to customer support and fraud teams.
- Goal: reduce per‑token unit cost ~40% and hit 95th%-tile p95 latency < 350ms for 1k QPS within production window.
- Security/compliance: audit logs and KMS integration are gating procurement.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level)
1) Week of Nov 1 — Pilot kickoff: Redwood PoC cluster (dedicated capacity), pilot dataset snapshot, success criteria defined (owner: BrightLane ML lead).
2) Nov 15 — Pilot review & SLA decision: internal execs to confirm go/no‑go and desired SLA (owner: BrightLane procurement).
3) Nov 29 — Contract & procurement: finalize MSA/PO timeline (owner: BrightLane procurement; Redwood legal standby).
4) Dec 6 — Production onramp plan: rollout schedule, monitoring hooks, and cost targets (owner: BrightLane platform eng).

Attaching a sprint card (mpa-sprintcard-v1.xlsx) and a short security overview (redwood-security-overview.pdf). I also created a living MPA doc and put it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cBrightLane-MPA/edit — feel free to add owners/constraints directly.

Next steps I suggest
- Can you confirm primary stakeholders for pilot sign‑off and procurement timelines by EOD Mon (Nov 2)?
- If those dates look OK I’ll schedule a 30min kickoff with Aditya and Monica (we’ll own setup + initial perf testing).

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks Lauren — this is very clear and helpful. A few clarifications from my side: 

- Stakeholders:
  - Pilot owner (ML): Daniel Park (daniel.park@brightlane.io)
  - Platform owner: Priya Suresh (priya.suresh@brightlane.io)
  - Procurement lead: Alan Chu (alan.chu@brightlane.io) — Alan has put a tentative procurement review on Nov 16 (internal calendar).
- Security: We’ll need Redwood’s SOC2 report and an outline of audit-log retention. Can you confirm those two items?
- Decision timing: Nov 15 target for pilot review looks achievable, Nov 29 for contract seems tight but doable if nothing major pops up.

If you can update the MPA doc with the named owners above I’ll circulate to execs today. Also — is there a short checklist we can hand to our security team?

On the pilot kickoff, Nov 3–5 is tight for our infra team; Nov 8 morning PST would work better.

—Sarah

Thanks — I’ll also send calendar invites after Aditya confirms availability.

—Lauren
